host.current_host: Since D27 (2026-10-14) the product is a static website built by Python every 10 minutes (.github/workflows/website.yml cron */10, line 15) and served by GitHub Pages (DECISIONS D27; AGENTS.md 'What this is'). summary: Recommended first build: C2, no globe library. Python builds fixed-region PNG layers and fixed-transect SVG profiles: MRMS echo-top height classes from 11 of the 33 MSL levels (levels below ground masked with a Python-built terrain grid), GOES ACHA cloud-top height classes (satellite estimate, uncorrected for parallax), and a GOES Band 13 picture. The browser shows them as Leaflet image overlays on the vendored Leaflet 1.9.4 map (sha256 matches the npm file) and runs 6 new small duties. C1 (pydeck to a MapLibre globe, deck.gl) is a gated Phase 5 owner decision: pydeck 0.9.3 has no GlobeView class (only map_projection='globe' on MapLibre); deck.gl 9.4.0 has no VolumeLayer; deck.gl marks GlobeView experimental; pydeck's HTML template loads third-party scripts and stylesheets even with offline=True; the app would need numpy (new installer, rule 2).
recommendation: C2 for the first build. C1 only if the owner approves D-G1 and the JS duties in js_duties (G1-G8). Neither option makes the storms true 3D volumes; C2 uses 2.5D encodings, and the owner's 3D wish is met only partly in both.

C2_flat_map_2_5d.what_it_is: Leaflet 1.9.4 (already vendored) with Python-built image overlays and SVG profiles. No globe, no WebGL, no new library.
cannot_do_that_owner_asked: Rotate, tilt or orbit the view, or show storm columns or volumes in 3D.
Place cloud tops at their true height over terrain: cloud tops are drawn as height classes, and the uncorrected position is disclosed (parallax.json wording).
Look like a globe (it is a Mercator map, as today).
Click any point for a live profile: a static site can only show fixed, pre-built transects.
Animate between frames: frames are 10-minute pictures; no temporal or level interpolation (AGENTS rule 5).
C2_flat_map_2_5d.protects: Rule 4 and D1 (Python builds all data; no framework; no new library). The no-CDN rule (AGENTS rule 4). Deterministic offline states (every file comes from the site). Phone bytes (about 0.66 MB added per build). Honest labels: estimates are drawn as estimates. Reuse of website/gridded.py.

C1_globe_pydeck_maplibre.what_it_is: pydeck 0.9.3 (Python spec builder) driving a MapLibre globe projection with deck.gl 9.4.0 layers, in a custom page template.
cannot_do_that_owner_asked: Show storm volumes without custom WebGL/GLSL: deck.gl 9.4.0 dist.min.js has 0 matches for VolumeLayer (live re-check 2026-10-17); 3D texture upload exists (setTexture3DData, 1 match), so the volume shader would be hand-written.

Use a 'GlobeView' from pydeck: pydeck 0.9.3 has no GlobeView class. deck.py lines 93-95: 'Map projection to use with map_provider=maplibre. Values can be globe or mercator.' deck.gl's GlobeView page: 'This class is experimental, which means it does not provide the compatibility and stability that one would typically expect from other View classes.' MapLibre release note: 'Globe View or Globe Projection was released as part of MapLibre GL JS 5.0.0'.

Run offline with pydeck's own page: index.j2 loads a Mapbox GL or Google Maps script (lines 6-10), Bootstrap and Font Awesome from maxcdn (lines 11-12) and MapLibre CSS from unpkg (line 13), and the widget stylesheet from jsDelivr (html.py:37, index.j2:15) even when offline=True (which inlines the 4,269,385 B widget bundle, html.py:49-53).
Be offline-safe with pydeck's default style: map_styles.py uses basemaps.cartocdn.com URLs, which D9 records as needing a key.
Guarantee WebGL2 on crew laptops: WebView2's WebGL2 support is not stated in the pages read; the MSHTML fallback has no WebGL2 (webgl-runtime.json).
C1_globe_pydeck_maplibre.protects: A real globe and 3D columns on desktops and tablets, and volumes the owner asked for, once parallax is corrected (Phase 2 of the plan).

js_duties: E1 [existing; map.js:1400] Frame playback timer. Reason: the frame advance is a timer in the viewer's browser.
E2 [existing; map.js:1449-1452] Scrub by pointer events. Reason: pointer position exists only in the browser.
E3 [existing; map.js:1493] Layer menu open and close, tap-outside dismissal. Reason: DOM events only.
E4 [existing] Town sheet and List show and hide on tap. Reason: DOM show and hide.
E5 [existing; map.js:1727-1730] Geolocation request and marker. Reason: navigator.geolocation exists only in the browser.
E6 [existing; map.js:116-119] Same-origin fetch of data/*.json with plain-words failure reasons. Reason: the browser makes the request.
E7 [existing; base.html:167-168, map.js:1682] Page-age check, warning past 25 minutes. Reason: the viewer's clock, not the build's.
N1 [C2 new] Layer switch and opacity for echo-top and cloud-top overlays. Reason: DOM control state; Python supplies the legend text and frame list.
N2 [C2 new] Rolling echo-top window on the existing timeline (reuses E1-E2). Reason: the same browser timer; no new geometry.
N3 [C2 new] Show one pre-built transect SVG chosen from three fixed transects. Reason: choosing a file is a DOM event; no geometry runs in the browser.
N4 [C2 new] Per-layer 'could not load' text when an image or SVG fails (error event). Reason: only the browser sees a failed request; wording comes from Python.
N5 [C2 new] Per-layer age clock, valid time against the viewer's now, updated each minute. Reason: the viewer's clock; Python cannot know it.
N6 [C2 new] Accessible names and aria-pressed state on new controls. Reason: attributes are set in the DOM.
G1 [C1 only] Load vendored globe modules; show '3D view could not load' on failure. Reason: modules execute in the browser.
G2 [C1 only] WebGL2 probe before the globe is created. Reason: only the browser knows its GPU context.
G3 [C1 only] webglcontextlost and restored handling. Reason: GPU events exist only in the browser.
G4 [C1 only] Turn Python layer JSON into deck.gl layer props. Reason: hand-written glue between Python data and the library.
G5 [C1 only] Fetch per-frame data and set layer data on time change. Reason: browser network and timing.
G6 [C1 only] Upload per-frame 3D textures for volume layers. Reason: GPU upload is browser-only, and with no VolumeLayer the shader is hand-written.
G7 [C1 only] Vertical exaggeration control, labelled on screen. Reason: a UI event feeding a shader uniform.
G8 [C1 only] Reset-view button and keyboard camera keys. Reason: UI events; the library handles drag internally.
Count: C2 needs 13 (E1-E7, N1-N6); the existing 7 are approved in D28. C1 adds G1-G8 (21 in all). Each duty is documented inline (AGENTS rule 4).

integrity_policy: Exact versions only. Each vendored file's sha256 is written to a manifest that the build checks, and a test fails on any mismatch. Files come from the site, never a CDN; a test finds no URL outside the site in built HTML, JS, CSS or JSON. SRI is not needed for same-origin files. New versions need 14 days of age before adoption (the artifact instructions' rule, applied here as a proposal). No paid token or key appears in browser code (globe-libs.json: Cesium ion token, Google key). The app's Folium Leaflet 1.9.3 comes from jsDelivr with no integrity attribute (folium.py:27, read live); D23's 'Folium bundles Leaflet' is wrong and needs a correction entry.

offline_and_selftest.self_test: updater.selftest runs with NETWORK False and checks only HTTP status >= 400 (updater.py:141-142; default timeout 90 s, updater.py:122-158). /globe returns 200 whether or not the setting is on; only data routes and the 3D controls depend on it. Expected states in the self-test: live feeds 'Off' (weather.py:517-518), 3D view 'Off (setting)'. No state is an all-clear. The self-test cannot see JavaScript or images, so UI checks run in a dev-only browser job (not in requirements.txt). check-app.yml has no browser step (lines 22-26).

states.cloud_top_GOES_ACHA: Live at most 20 min old; Stale to 180 min; Unavailable beyond.
states.transects: Follow the MRMS state. Unavailable when the MRMS frame is unavailable.
states.terrain_grid: Static, version-stamped. If missing, echo tops are not drawn and the view says 'Terrain unavailable: heights shown above sea level only'.

evidence_kinds_and_freshness.loud_failure: Every product key must exist in sources.CONTRACTS and FRESH_SECONDS. A unit test fails on a missing key. The silent 3600 s default at weather.py:232 is not allowed.

alert_null_geometry: Matching is unchanged: polygon contains the place; else UGC zone, county or fire-zone codes (AGENTS rule 6; D10; sources.parse_alerts and alert_references).
Alert with geometry: draw the warning polygon as an outline with event name and end time. No fill colour by severity.

Null geometry matched by zone code: draw the NWS forecast-zone outline, dashed, labelled 'Zone outline: the alert names this zone; the warning area is not given'. Add a marker and text at the town. Listed on the Now page with the existing note (D27).
Zone code matched but outline not cached or fetch failed: marker and text 'Alert names this zone; outline not available'. Never omitted.
Town point check failed: 'Alerts not checked' with age (D27). Never 'no alerts'.
Parity test on three fixtures (zone-only, out-of-state code, cancel during an outage): the map list and the Now page list are identical, 3 of 3, and no town with a matching code reads 'no alert'.
No height or extrusion encoding of alerts, candidates or hazards (supervisor product critic). Height encodings apply only to radar and satellite estimates.

storms_handling.levels: MRMS heights are heightAboveSea in metres, 500-19,000 m (mrms.json). Labels say 'above sea level'. Billings ground is 952 m (terrain.json): the 0.5 km level is 452 m below ground there, and 1.0 km is 48 m above ground, inside the margin. The task states the 0.5 km level is below ground over most of Montana.
storms_handling.below_ground_mask: A level is below ground when its height is under ground + 50 m. The margin is about twice the DEM-to-NWS difference at KBIL (20-27 m, terrain.json). Below-ground levels never make an echo top and are not drawn. With no terrain grid, the echo layer is Unavailable rather than drawn unmasked.
storms_handling.no_data_codes: MRMS -99 and -999 both mean 'No radar data' (grey hatch). Their meanings are unverified (mrms.json; NSSL table returned HTTP 503 each time). Never 0 dBZ, and blank is never 'clear'. Unit tests: missing is never converted to 0 dBZ; threshold_count_parity difference is 0 (evaluation-predeclared.json).
storms_handling.echo_top_definition: Highest valid level at or above 35 dBZ among the 11 levels, above ground. Height is the level's own height, not interpolated. Height classes (km above sea level, e.g. 3-6, 6-9, 9-12, above 12) use one sequential single-hue palette, never a red-to-green severity ramp (rendering-options.json legend_rules). Columns with valid data and no level at or above 35 dBZ read 'No echo at 35 dBZ or more; not an all-clear'.
storms_handling.parallax: Does not apply to MRMS, which is a ground-grid product (mrms.json grid facts). It applies to satellite cloud tops only.
storms_handling.legend_echo: Radar echo top (estimate): the highest level at or above 35 dBZ, height above sea level, from NOAA MRMS data. Radar estimate only: not hail, not hail size, not damage. Grey = no radar data. Blank = no echo at 35 dBZ or more, which is not an all-clear. Heights are level heights, rounded up to the next MRMS level.
storms_handling.legend_cloud: Not corrected for cloud-top height. The cloud top is drawn where the satellite's ground grid puts it, away from the satellite (north-west or north-east of Montana): about 3 to 4 km off for a 2 km top, about 20 to 33 km off for a 12 to 15 km top. Estimated cloud-top height, satellite estimate. Cloud base is not observed. (parallax.json ui_legend_uncorrected_phase1, verbatim.)
storms_handling.no_interpolation: No interpolation across time (missing slot shown as a gap, metric missing_slot_shown_as_gap = 1.000), across levels, or in space. Transects sample the nearest cell.
storms_handling.vertical_scale: Profiles state the vertical stretch on screen, for example 'Vertical scale x2'. Without a stated stretch, profiles read as flat (rendering-options.json).
storms_handling.dropped: Extruded walls, storm-motion arrows, arrival times, probability shells, hatch as severity (supervisor product critic).

default_off_setting.app: DEFAULTS['view_3d'] = False (pattern of app.py:64-71; read via setting() app.py:220-221). /globe returns 200 with 'The 3D view is off. Turn it on in Settings.' /globe/data/* and /static/globe/* return 404 while off. The toggle posts to /settings/view_3d.
default_off_setting.website: Build flag --experimental-3d, default off (argparse at build.py:481-487). The default build writes no data/echo, data/cloud, data/satellite or data/transects files, no 3D strings and no links; test: _site has none of these. The flagged build labels every layer 'Experimental' and 'Not an all-clear'.
default_off_setting.exposure: Not linked from the Now page until P2 passes. Homeowner, adjuster and insurer use is out of scope until the owner decides (owner_decisions).

route_security_tests: App: GET /globe without the hw_session cookie returns 403 (launcher.py Gate, lines 157-170).
App: symlinks inside static/globe are refused.
App: with view_3d off, /globe/data/* and /static/globe/* return 404.

App: /globe responses carry Content-Security-Policy (default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; frame-ancestors 'none') and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. The app sends neither today (app-integration.json).
App: no response contains a key, token or secret-looking query string (grep test).
App: frames carry ETag and Cache-Control max-age of 600 s (matches D28's 10-minute cache).
App: a frame over 300 KB or an SVG over 30 KB fails the budget test.
Website: built HTML, JS, CSS and JSON reference no host outside the site (allow-list empty); no inline event attributes; no eval or new Function; fetch only to same-origin data/*.json.
Website: GitHub Pages cannot set response headers, so any CSP is a meta tag. Standard behaviour: frame-ancestors is ignored in meta (not checked live here).

risks_ranked: 1. JavaScript scope creep against rule 4 and roadmap Next 9: C1 adds 8 hand-written duties, one of them GLSL; map.js is already 2,155 lines. Mitigation: C2 first; each C1 duty needs owner sign-off.

2. Parallax over-reading: uncorrected cloud tops sit 3-4 km off for a 2 km top and 20-33 km off for a 12-15 km top (parallax.json). A 3D look invites 'holographic' expectations. Mitigation: verbatim legend; no fly-to; correction only with cloud-top heights (Phase 2 of the plan).

3. Cloud-top validity: no ground truth; Montana valid cells correlate r = -0.62 with Band 13 brightness temperature, and warm brightness temperature at valid high tops is unexplained (goes-aws.json). Mitigation: 'estimated' label; acha metrics; no damage language.

4. Below-ground levels: 0.5 km is 452 m below ground at Billings; 1.0 km sits inside the 50 m margin. A wrong mask mislabels heights. Mitigation: terrain mask with margin; unmasked echo is never drawn.
5. -99 and -999 meanings unverified (mrms.json). A wrong guess could show dry areas as radar gaps or hide gaps. Mitigation: both 'No radar data'; NSSL table check in P0.

6. Licence and terms: GOES files carry 'Access is restricted to approved users only' while NODD says open (goes-aws.json). Actions terms say develop and test, and do not use Actions as a content delivery network (gh-terms-1, gh-terms-3). Mitigation: owner or counsel reading before P1; host alternative (ROADMAP Next 8).

7. Schedule reliability: 5-minute floor, delays, possible drops, 60-day disable (gh-sched-1, -2, -4, -6). A missed build becomes Stale; the rolling echo window gaps. Mitigation: product timestamps (next_expected_utc), page-age warning at 25 min.
8. Phone and cellular cost unmeasured: C1 loops 14-100 MB per 2 h (rendering-options.json phase_4). No device tests exist (SwiftShader only).

9. App path installer and WebView: numpy and eccodes (62.16 MB Linux wheels, no Windows eccodes wheel); WebView2 WebGL2 unverified; MSHTML fallback has no WebGL2 (webgl-runtime.json). C2 avoids all three.

10. pydeck template loads third-party resources and bundles its own MapLibre 5.14.0 and deck.gl ~9.3 (index.j2:6-15; frontend_semver.py '~9.3.*'). Mitigation: no pydeck HTML page; custom template if C1.
11. Self-test blind spot: HTTP status only (updater.py:141-142); JavaScript and images are untested by it; check-app.yml has no browser step. Mitigation: dev-only browser job; smoke_map.py extended.
12. Silent freshness default: unknown feed keys get 3600 s (weather.py:232). Mitigation: loud-failure test on every product key.
13. Sample is not live: the 2.24 MB sample uses invented pictures; real frame sizes come from P0 measurement.
